answer: Tie eligibility to a unique, aged external name: each agent must bind a domain or on-chain handle that has paid renewal fees for at least a year and cannot be reused. An honest agent already holds one such name. A farmer who wants a thousand clones must buy or wait out a thousand aged names, which is costly and slow. The rising price of old names is the signal that sybil supply is tight. Brand-new handles make only a faint ripple and stay out of the main river of reward-eligible agents until their aging clock runs out.
